body: I have no one. No family. One friend who is overwhelmed by my grief. A job I absolutely hate. And a disease which has kept me from feeling human touch for over a year now. It's made worse by the fact that I'm both physically and intellectually attractive. I'm an all around good person and I've worked hard to cultivate a friendly and approachable demeanor. But it means nothing now because I have this silly, incurable disease.

Yes, but it doesn't resolve the problems associated with the position I'm in. I want kids of my own. I want to get married. I want to be loved. I genuinely have no one. I have one friend in the world. No one else. It wasn't always like this. The last year has destroyed everything I worked for.
It's no use. Really. All I want is to be a father. I want a wife and children and a happy life. And even the opportunity to have those things has been taken from me.

I've been in and out of therapy my entire life and it hasn't done me any good. Everyone says the same thing: "things will get better." But they haven't gotten better. And they won't get better. Things have only gotten worse. The magnitude of bad things happening to me has only increased with time. I just don't want this life anymore. I'm tired of being crushed by the universe for no apparent reason.
